notes.title: Teaser & Release Date for Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift 🐈🏎️
notes.notes:
Hello lasagna lovers 🍝

Out of the garage and on to the road! Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift will drift its way to PC and console on September 10th!

[previewyoutube=meQD_cRQyjU;full][/previewyoutube]
Did you know?
In Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift, you can play against up to eight players online worldwide, or enjoy local multiplayer mode for up to four players with split-screen mode! Perfect for frenzied competitions between friends or on family game nights.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636063/1c5b43f47fcd0e97fc140756aa6efd9ba6038396.jpg
Ready to race against a real heavyweight?
